CHAPTER.VERS: [A Psalm] of David. Maschil. Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, Whose sin is covered.
Blessed is [the] man to whom Yahweh does not impute iniquity, And in whose spirit there is no guile.
When I kept silent, my bones wasted away Through my groaning all the day long.
For day and night your hand was heavy on me: My moisture was changed in the drought of summer. Selah.
I acknowledged my sin to you, And my iniquity I did not hide: I said, I will confess my transgressions to Yahweh; And you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
For this let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found: Surely when the great waters overflow they will not reach to him.
You are my hiding-place; you will preserve me from trouble; You will circle me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.
I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you will go: I will counsel you with my eye on you.
Many sorrows will be to the wicked; But he who trusts in Yahweh, loving-kindness will circle him about.
